column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiMailCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column3: The default every earlier version shipped for recall.server-name, and the field's Java default: MailConfig#materializeText compares an operator's value with it byte for byte and, while it is still this built-in text, replaces it with the language file's text in the server's language (maintainer decision 2026-09-25, UltiKits/UltiMail#22); the text players see is the file's value
